correctness.rationale: Socle equals the degree-two monomial space; minimal ideals are exactly its lines. Squaring generator images gives the full monomial effective group in odd characteristic and all GL4 in characteristic two. The exterior-square rank dichotomy yields two even-field orbits. Odd-field support graphs have counts 1/2/3 and two one-parameter inverse-ratio families, while projective matching products classify full support with an S3 Burnside count of ((q-1)^2+3(q-1)+2gcd(3,q-1))/6. Every graph form and finite-field fixed point count follows by explicit normalization. A standalone BFS enumerator verified q=2,3,4,5,7,11, including all projective points; these tests do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The algebra is a natural short squarefree monomial quotient, and embedded minimal-ideal orbits are a canonical local-algebra invariant. The full classification identifies a sharp characteristic-two collapse and an odd-field quadratic family with arithmetic gcd(3,q-1) variation. The six strata locate exactly which support graphs carry nontrivial moduli, making the precise finite-field invariant useful for studying ideal moduli of related short local algebras. This is neither a single arbitrary numeric instance nor a renaming of an existing theorem.
